title: Bouncy-QQ Funky Oven-Baked Custard Dutch Oven Pozole
description: A low-glycemic, Sonoran-inspired dish featuring a creamy custard and a variety of spices.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, epazote, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the hominy, chicken, and 2 cups of water to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
While the pozole is cooking, prepare the custard. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and shredded cheese until well combined.
Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the cooked chicken and hominy mixture.
Pour the custard mixture into the pot and stir to combine.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven. Broil for 5-7 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and set.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro, scallions, or a sprinkle of queso fresco, if desired.
If using cayenne pepper, sprinkle on top of each serving for an extra kick.
Garnish with a dollop of sour cream or Greek yogurt, if desired.
Consider serving with a side of warm tortillas, sliced radishes, and a dollop of crema.
This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
It's also great for a potluck or a casual gathering with friends and family.
Be sure to adjust the amount of cayenne pepper to your desired level of spiciness.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
